Bea: Quick thread for EdgeAI Evening booth. Need final speaker slide, bench card, swag manifest, courier ETA, and QR lead flow.
Owen: Speaking slot confirmed for Bea (19:00) and Lee (19:20). Lee, slide deck by Tue please.
Lee: Will do. Also want a 1-slide benchmark: 95th/99th latency + cost per 1k tokens. Keep printable.
Harper: Swag ordered: 180 performance tees, 120 stickers, 80 reusable bottles. Vendor offers printed hang tags with bench blurb for +$0.40 each. Worth it?
Bea: Yes put bench blurb on hang tags. Shortline: "Predictable LLM inference at 1/3 cost vs baseline" (we'll refine wording).
Owen: Lead flow: QR -> short webform (email, company, interest_level) -> Airtable -> HubSpot webhook. Add field 'swag_claimed'. Use UTM=EdgeAI_evening_0426.
ShipBot: Courier label created AWB: ES-778899. Pickup 2024-04-24 08:00.
Harper: Packing list: 2x pop-up banners, crate w/foam, 3x company laptops, hotspot, power strip, gaffer tape, swag bins. I'll post photo when loaded.
Bea: Run-of-show: 17:00 load-in, 18:00 speaker check, 19:00 talk, 19:30 demos, 20:30 teardown. Volunteers for demos?
Owen: I can do 19:25-20:00. Lee covers 19:30-20:00.
Harper: Will add QR short link to table cards and print 100 one-pagers with the bench snapshot + CTA to join webinar May 8.
Bea: Action items: Lee slides Tue, Harper orders hang-tag printing, Owen wires webhook to Airtable/HubSpot and secures auth token server-side. Final confirmations by Mon EOD.
